name: RobotPowerM5 meta4V12
summary: RobotPowerM5 is an M5 timeframe momentum-based Expert Advisor that generates trade signals from a combination of oscillators and trend filters. It enters positions when momentum indicators confirm directional strength and exits via fixed take-profit or stop-loss levels. The EA includes lot sizing and basic risk controls but appears to lack advanced money management features.
summary_zh: RobotPowerM5是一个基于M5时间框架动量策略的EA，通过振荡器和趋势过滤器的组合产生交易信号。当动量指标确认方向性强度时入场，通过固定止盈或止损出场。该EA包含手数设置和基本风险控制，但似乎缺乏高级资金管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用动量策略，在M5短周期时间框架上运行，适合捕捉短期价格波动。入场条件依赖于多个动量类指标（如RSI、MACD、随机指标等）的共振确认，当指标集体指向同一方向时触发交易信号。出场条件使用固定的止盈和止损水平，没有追踪止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理基于固定手数或简单的资金比例计算，没有采用马丁格尔或网格策略。资金管理方面相对简单，没有复杂的动态仓位调整或基于波动率的手数计算。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为基础，缺乏对市场状态变化的自适应能力。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a momentum-based strategy operating on the M5 short-term timeframe, suitable for capturing short-term price movements. Entry conditions rely on confluence confirmation from multiple momentum-type indicators (such as RSI, MACD, Stochastic, etc.), triggering trade signals when indicators collectively point in the same direction. Exit conditions use fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing is based on fixed lots or a simple account percentage calculation, without employing martingale or grid strategies. Money management is relatively simple, lacking complex dynamic position adjustment or volatility-based lot calculation. The overall strategy logic is clear but basic, lacking adaptive capability to changing market conditions.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术数字用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 策略逻辑清晰易懂，多指标共振确认减少虚假信号
使用固定止损，每笔交易风险可控且预定义
不使用马丁格尔或网格策略，避免了账户爆仓的极端风险
M5时间框架适合短线交易，能快速响应市场变化
设有魔术数字区分订单，避免与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Clear and understandable strategy logic with multi-indicator confluence reducing false signals
Uses fixed stop-loss, making risk per trade controllable and predefined
No martingale or grid strategy, avoiding extreme account blowout risk
M5 timeframe suits short-term trading and responds quickly to market changes
Magic number identifies orders, preventing conflicts with other EAs
cons: 缺乏追踪止损机制，无法锁定浮动利润
M5短线交易受点差影响大，未内置点差过滤条件
仓位管理过于简单，未根据波动率动态调整手数
固定止盈止损不考虑市场波动率变化，在不同行情下可能不适配
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks trailing stop mechanism, unable to lock in floating profits
M5 short-term trading is heavily affected by spread, no built-in spread filter
Position sizing is too simple, no dynamic lot adjustment based on volatility
Fixed TP/SL doesn't account for market volatility changes, may be maladaptive across different market conditions
Missing new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions on the same bar
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止盈止损，使出场水平适应市场波动率
添加追踪止损功能以保护浮动利润
引入点差过滤器，在点差过大时禁止开仓
添加新K线检查，确保每根K线只开一次仓
实现基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位管理
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic take-profit and stop-loss to adapt exit levels to market volatility
Implement trailing stop functionality to protect floating profits
Introduce spread filter to prohibit opening positions when spread is too wide
Add new bar check to ensure only one entry per bar
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account balance percentage

risk_points: M5剥头皮交易受点差和滑点影响大，未设点差过滤
缺少新K线检查可能导致同一K线重复开仓
固定止盈止损在不同波动率环境下可能不合理
risk_points_en: M5 scalping is heavily impacted by spread and slippage, no spread filter implemented
Missing new bar check may cause repeated position opening on the same bar
Fixed TP/SL may be inappropriate under varying volatility conditions
